limits: No Windows or ART execution claimed by local host tests/cross-compilation.
Real Linux and wired Windows public corpus use real timerfd/inotify; the complete epoll host uses declared payload lifetime boundaries.
The host counter includes native-event adapter allocations equally; byte counts are requested C++ allocation sizes, not RSS.
